item.title: Which Friend Gets My Face

item.tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

answer_sheet.Which person to replace: The blonde woman on the right. Leave the bearded man on the left alone.
answer_sheet.Style: Keep it looking like the original beach photo; I want to be recognisable, so my hair can come with my face.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Keep the original wide 16:9 framing; free-tier size is fine.

must_haves: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
The bearded man on the left still looks like the same person (small drift from a redrawn photo is acceptable).
The woman on the right is recognisably the person in portrait-woman.jpg (her hair may come with the face), blended to the beach lighting and head angle.
The bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing look the same at a glance.
changed: 2026-11-01: recognisable over untouched (user decision): the hair, and on video the clothes, may come with the new person; everything else stays

turns.text: Can you put my face from this park selfie onto someone in this beach photo? Just swap one face and leave everything else alone. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—the dedicated **photo face swap costs 10 credits for one run**. Swapping only one face or using a smaller image does **not** reduce that fixed price; “shorter” only applies to video.

There is a **5-credit image-editing option** on the free plan (Flux 2 Klein at 640px), but it may change other details and is less reliable for a face-only swap. Given your “leave everything else alone” requirement, I recommend the dedicated 10-credit face swap with a selected-face mapping.

**I haven’t started anything or spent any credits.** Which person should receive your face—the **man on the left** or the **woman on the right**—and do you approve the **10-credit** run?
dialog.user: The blonde woman on the right—use my face from portrait-woman.jpg and leave the bearded man on the left alone. For the 10-credit face swap, ok, go ahead with that.

turns.agent:
The 10-credit face swap was blocked because your account has insufficient credits. **No image was generated and no generation credits were spent.** Face detection was free.

I haven’t switched to the cheaper editor or retried. To use the selected-face swap on only the blonde woman, you’ll need a balance of at least **10 credits**.
